Automation: Rules reference · play automation in progress

You speak the names that once meant safety, and hear your companions breathe more steadily.

Rules

Action
Main Action
Attribute
None — no roll
Target / range / shape
Self and willing allies within 2 squares.
Duration
Remove Frightened immediately; the defensive Boon lasts until the start of your next turn.
Equipment / acquisition
No item needed unless named above.
Limits
Repeatable; pay the action and any stated costs each use.
Type
Magic

Call the names of those who kept you safe. Until the start of your next turn, these allies gain 1 Boon to defense against forced movement and may reduce temporary Frightened by 1 immediately.
